title: `Description-Content-Type: text/plain; x*` crashes `Metadata.from_email` with `IndexError`
spec:
This is the `packaging` library (Python 3, no dependencies; the code is in `src/packaging/`). Run the tests with `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests --ignore=tests/property` (about a minute).

```python
from packaging import metadata
def load(dct):
    return metadata.Metadata.from_email(
        "Metadata-Version: 2.6\nName: packaging\nVersion: 1.0\n"
        f"Description-Content-Type: {dct}\n")
load("text/plain; x*")    # IndexError: string index out of range
```
Expected: the usual `ExceptionGroup` holding one `metadata.InvalidMetadata` whose `field` is `"description-content-type"`.

The message should include the repr of the offending value and say it "is not a valid content type", e.g. `'text/plain; x*' is not a valid content type for 'description-content-type'`.

Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: the reported example produces the expected output
the underlying problem is fixed, not just the reported input
